title: Line-item grids still draw English under zh-CN: a boolean column's Yes / No options (deriveMasterDetail) and a file cell's "N files" / "File" (GridField displayText)
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect with named producers, from the os-dev report on objectui#12915 (PR #12923, out-of-scope observations). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

## What

Two English literals remain in the line-items grid family, read on objectui `main` `2cfdc99`:

1. **Boolean columns.** `packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts:113`–`:114` hydrates a `boolean` / `toggle` child field into a `select` column whose options are `{ label: 'Yes', value: 'true' }` and `{ label: 'No', value: 'false' }`, English in every locale. The editable grid's select shows them, and after PR #12923 (objectui#12915) the read-only table and the print page do too: a read-only boolean line cell now reads `Yes` where it read `true`.
2. **File cells.** `GridField`'s `displayText` (`packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx:510`, `:512`) prints a multi-file cell as `` `${n} files` `` and a nameless file as `'File'`, English in every locale. Both the list-mode cell and the read-only table read it.

**reach:** a public door. A `record:line_items` or master-detail grid whose child object has a boolean or toggle field, or a file field holding more than one file, rendered on a zh-CN (or any non-English) page, on screen and in print. Read from source; not driven in a browser (the showcase invoice line has a single-file `receipt` and no boolean). objectui#11689 (closed) fixed read-only booleans elsewhere; this hydration path was not part of it.

## Expected

Both read the bundle: the boolean options through existing yes / no keys where one fits (objectui#11689 is the precedent for read-only booleans), and the file text through a counted key with its plural family in every pack. A pin renders each under zh-CN.

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage, then `domain:ui`. The first landings are `deriveMasterDetail.ts` (`optionsFor`) and `GridField.tsx` (`displayText`).

**Dedupe** (open and closed): objectui issues searched for "GridField line items English Yes No boolean options files File displayText zh i18n deriveMasterDetail": 26 hits; of the first 10, the only open one is objectui#12915 (this finding's source). The nearest closed ones are objectui#11689 (read-only booleans, a different render path), #11160, #11145 and #11131 (the line-items chrome family, which named neither literal).

Dedupe words: deriveMasterDetail optionsFor Yes No, line items boolean column English, GridField displayText files File, multi-file cell count.
